original.target_description: Single reported experiment: gender main effect in GLM of choice-model sensitivity to friendliness versus sexual interest among heterosexual undergraduates; includes clothing style, presentation time and affect factors.

n.sample_role: Participants; analytic sample size for the target GLM is not explicitly identified.
n.exclusions: No exclusions or test-specific analytic participant count stated. The Participants section reports 280 enrolled participants; no analytic N was derived from degrees of freedom.
n.location: PMC author manuscript, Method > Participants, first sentence.
n.quote: Two hundred eighty heterosexual undergraduate men (63.6%) and women (36.4%) participated in exchange for course credit.

es.location: PMC author manuscript, Results, paragraph beginning “The statistical model predicting choice-model parameter estimates of sensitivity to positive affect”; main effect for gender (HTML has no page markers).
es.quote: Compared with women (ln(α) = 2.30), men (ln(α) = 1.61) were significantly less sensitive to the distinction between friendliness and sexual interest, F (1, 278) = 123.38, p < .001, η p 2 = .326.

p.location: PMC author manuscript, Results, paragraph beginning “The statistical model predicting choice-model parameter estimates of sensitivity to positive affect”; main effect for gender (HTML has no page markers).
p.quote: Compared with women (ln(α) = 2.30), men (ln(α) = 1.61) were significantly less sensitive to the distinction between friendliness and sexual interest, F (1, 278) = 123.38, p < .001, η p 2 = .326.

replication.target_description: Perceptual mechanisms that characterize gender differences in decoding women's sexual intent; replicated study 1; male participants were less sensitive to the distinction between friendliness and sexual interest than women, suggesting that gender differences are due to perceptual insensitivity in men; Repeated measures ANOVA

n.sample_role: N (R), project authors’ replication sample size; analytic role not independently documented
